tickets.title: US005: Boosted Listing Management
tickets.description:
As a Student Union Administrator, I want to set up and manage a flat fee for students to "boost" their listings, so that we can raise funds for club activities without taking illegal percentage fees from peer-to-peer sales.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Pass/Fail: The Admin dashboard allows the administrator to configure the flat fee price for a "Boosted Listing".
2. Pass/Fail: Listings that have been paid to be boosted are visually highlighted and pinned to the top of the search results for users.
